description: This file contains automated tests for a custom EventEmitter class, focusing on adding, removing, and emitting event listeners, including the behavior when removing listeners during emit execution.

classes.name: EventEmitter
classes.description: A class that manages event listeners and their invocation, allowing adding, removing, and emitting events.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Register a callback function to be invoked when a specified event is emitted.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Remove a specific callback function from an event's listener list.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Retrieve the array of listener functions registered for a specific event.

methods.name: removeAllListeners
methods.description: Remove all listener functions for a specific event.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Invoke all listener functions registered for a specific event.
